title: Rainy neon alley
prompt_en: 21:9 medium shot. A woman in a trench coat walks toward camera through a narrow alley at night, rain falling, neon signs reflecting in puddles. Camera slowly dollies backward. Teal and magenta palette, moody noir.
prompt_zh: 21:9 中景。穿风衣的女人在夜晚窄巷中朝镜头走来，雨水落下，霓虹招牌倒映在水洼里。镜头缓慢后移。青色与洋红色调，氛围感黑色电影。
why_it_works: Walk-toward-camera with dolly back keeps the subject size stable, reducing drift; rain and reflections add depth.
